floorPlans.introduction: Compare the one- and two-bedroom apartment types and their balcony variants. Each sheet includes the unit references published for that layout.
floorPlans.note: Saleable totals include the suite and balcony shown on the sheet. Ranges apply to the units listed in the brochure. Confirm the final area and floor for your apartment.

review.images: Seven native developer images from the Abode brochure. The main rendering is from the named Abode section. Wider Woods courtyard and wellness scenes are identified as shared setting.
review.location: Page 22 of the original brochure specifically labels the Abode building within the Woods cluster. The five journey estimates are from Sobha’s Abode landing page. The broker map coordinate is not presented as a verified building entrance.
review.floorPlans: Fourteen full residence drawings from physical pages 26–52. All printed saleable totals and ranges were visually checked. The separate 30-page broker PDF matches physical pages 23–52 of the official brochure pixel for pixel at the comparison resolution. The 22-page broker file contains the brochure’s earlier material. Key plans remain available in the official original. The portal’s larger plan image count does not establish additional complete layouts.

unavailable: Exact entrance coordinates and contractual apartment areas.
